final_binding_obligations: Root must bind exact final source head/tree/manifest path/blob/file count, fresh isolated work/attempt, and current read-only donor identity by an explicit reviewed literal delta to both script and config.

Root must supply the actual fixed-source fixture dependency review and any existing binary/evidence-file bindings. An empty injection table, cache pathname, or a syntactically valid proof hash is not evidence of suitable helpers.
A peer must review bound script/config/request pins and actual operator invocation. This index does not choose or launch the latest candidate.
The execution owner must reconcile active launch state before another job writes the existing shared operator target.
Each actual command still needs complete logs, true nonzero failures, fresh original JUnit/count/roster evidence and unchanged clean source; no previous PASS carries across source changes.
synchronous_limits: Dispatch and waits use one absolute end. Synchronous filesystem/process creation is not hard-real-time; observed overrun fails. Owned process groups and local test results never establish escaped descendant, business, daemon or Root process completion.
